why: The stable door is named in the story: Hunter locked it before leaving (¶31), and it was found open the next morning (¶33).
The police theory says Simpson obtained 'in some way' a duplicate key to open the stable door (¶46).
The story states that the horse's bridle is missing (¶46).

text: What did the stranger want at the stable? — steal the horse
why: The police theory is that the stranger drugged the lad and intended to kidnap the horse (¶46), so the answer is a possibility the story has already raised.

text: Why did Straker go out at one in the morning? — to injure the horse
why: The story gives Straker's reason as anxiety about the horses and a wish to see that all was well (¶32). Nothing suggests he meant to injure the horse, so this answer points to a theory the story has not raised.

text: Where is Silver Blaze? — at a secret hiding-place
why: The police theory says the horse may have been led to a secret hiding-place or bolted onto the moors (¶46), so the question and this answer were already put forward.
